response_cutline.description: Subjects at or above Stable carry the cleared emergency-response claim; a response gap on a still-stable subject holds promotion through the shiproom gate.

records.title: Framework security advisory
records.subject_summary: Signed security advisory for the core framework train.
records.rationale: A signed advisory bound and digested, reaching the hosted, mirror, and offline channels, attributable and reversible with a runbook, audit markers present and reconciled, linked to the release graph and support export, with fresh proof; the lane is cleared.

records.title: Notebook extension/provider revocation
records.subject_summary: Emergency revocation of a notebook extension/provider key.
records.rationale: The revocation packet reached hosted and offline customers but the claimed mirror channel is still propagating; it narrows on the distribution-reach axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim — a mirror customer may not be left on a hosted-only path.

records.title: Managed-depth emergency-disable bundle
records.subject_summary: Emergency-disable bundle for a managed-depth integration.
records.rationale: The disable bundle reached hosted and mirror customers but the offline-import response has not landed for the claimed offline profile; it narrows on the distribution-reach axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: AI-adjacent security advisory
records.subject_summary: Break-glass security advisory for AI-adjacent surfaces.
records.rationale: A break-glass advisory shipped without audit markers; it narrows on the audit axis and holds promotion — a break-glass action may not bypass the audit markers.

records.title: Review high-severity postmortem
records.subject_summary: High-severity postmortem for the review/diff surfaces.
records.rationale: The postmortem records the timeline but the triggering action is not attributable to a named authority; it narrows on the attribution axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Companion extension/provider revocation
records.subject_summary: Emergency revocation for a companion-surface provider.
records.rationale: Policy permits reversing this revocation, but no reversal runbook is attached; it narrows on the reversibility axis and holds promotion — a reversible action must carry its reversal rule.

records.title: Data-rich emergency-disable bundle
records.subject_summary: Emergency-disable bundle for a data-rich result-grid integration.
records.rationale: The disable bundle was announced through a side channel and is not linked to the release artifact-graph or a support export; it narrows on the linkage axis and holds promotion — emergency evidence must be linked to release/support, not side channels.

records.title: Notebook security advisory
records.subject_summary: Security advisory for the notebook train.
records.rationale: The advisory text exists but the signed packet template is not yet bound and digested; it narrows on the template axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Managed-depth high-severity postmortem
records.rationale: The response proof packet aged past its freshness SLO; the lane narrows on the stale axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited and gated upstream.

records.title: Data-rich security advisory
records.rationale: No response proof packet is captured; the lane narrows on the stale axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited.

records.title: Review extension/provider revocation
records.subject_summary: Emergency revocation for a review-surface provider.

waiver.reason: Mirror operator re-propagation in progress; covered by an approved, time-boxed waiver.

records.rationale: A revocation that has not yet reached the claimed mirror, held by an unexpired waiver: it stays visible and narrowed on the distribution-reach axis but is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Companion emergency-disable bundle
records.subject_summary: Emergency-disable bundle for a companion-surface integration.
records.rationale: The offline channel's disable evidence has aged out of its window; the lane narrows on the distribution-reach axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited.

records.title: Framework high-severity postmortem
records.subject_summary: High-severity postmortem for the core framework train.
records.rationale: A bound postmortem reaching the hosted and mirror channels it claims (no offline customer profile), attributable, audit-complete, and linked to release/support with fresh proof; the lane is cleared.

scan_surface_parity.rationale: Every record's response scan and service-health/release-center surface agree, so a green emergency-response card can never mask a mirror/offline customer that never received the evidence, an unattributable break-glass action, or a side-channel-only disable.

publication.rationale: Hold while any release-blocking subject carries an emergency-response gap on a still-stable claim; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream. A protected lane whose advisory/revocation/disable evidence did not reach a claimed mirror/offline customer, or whose break-glass action bypassed audit/reconciliation, may not widen a stable claim without coverage.
